scientific_limitations: The result derives dimension-parameter asymptotics from the exact sharp radius of Theorem 4.1 of arXiv:2607.27272v1. It is not the classical bounded-holomorphic or vector-valued Bohr radius. The fixed-parameter remainder is not uniform as alpha tends to 1, and the endpoint window is handled by a separate profile. The lead preprint supplies sharpness; finite bisection checks are supplementary only. Publication and priority comparisons retain identified limitations.
title: A dimension–parameter boundary layer for sharp pluriharmonic Bohr radii
